# Introduction

::: {.content-visible when-format="pptx"}

## Normal Slide

This slide uses the normal "Title and Content" layout because it has no special class.

## Smaller Slide {.smaller}

This slide automatically gets mapped to the "Title and Content smaller" layout!

## Smallest Slide {.smallest}

This slide automatically gets mapped to the "Title and Content smallest" layout!

:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="pptx"}

## HTML only slide in smaller {.smaller}

This content will appear in HTML but not in the PowerPoint presentation.
This is useful for providing extra content or a different layout.

:::
